Yahoo Sports on Instagram: "The USMNT loses 2-0 to Portugal to wrap up their international friendlies window 😳

This latest loss follows the 5-2 defeat vs. Belgium on Saturday, both played on U.S. soil ahead of the World Cup."
content.text: The USMNT loses 2-0 to Portugal to wrap up their international friendlies window 😳This latest loss follows the 5-2 defeat vs. Belgium on Saturday, both played on U.S. soil ahead of the World Cup.Pochetino sucks , has never been good at coaching .We're a baseball and hockey country not a soccer countryWhy don’t European clubs give US player a chanceEh I’m not suprised, we’re more of a 🏈 country 😂😂😂What they thought they could win 😂It’s not quite so doom and gloom. Poch didn’t play with a striker for some reason. A striker could have made runs to create space for Pulisic and McKennie. Defensively we looked much stronger with Richards and Trusty. Morris also did solid, and we didn’t even have Adams available. One of the goals was a sloppy give away by McKennie that lead to a lethal counter. My main concern is our LW. I like what Tillman did at PSV, but he’s having a down year and it shows. He’s not aggressive enough for me. It’s clear all offensive threats come from Pulisic of McKennie but Tillman needs to be one of themPochetino is not a winner, has never been a winner and will never be a winner. He often spends a good chunk of his time building excuses for his failures. With him at the helm, there’s only so far the team will go in the World Cup. Ask PSG and Tottenham😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽What do we expect? It’s good we’re playing these tough matches against good opponents. Would we rather play Venezuela and El Salvador and win? Or face good nations and get humbled.
